purpose: Check whether a corrected GBIF COL XR Actinopterygii occurrence query returns records close to five DOTr/JICA freshwater environmental-survey stations, then run one wider Pampanga-Bulacan discovery rectangle. This is candidate discovery only, not a waterbody checklist.

parameters.checklistName: Catalogue of Life eXtended Release (COL XR)

queryDefinition.stationWindowMethod: One square search window per JICA station, centered on the environmental-survey station coordinate and extending 0.01 degrees in each cardinal direction (about 1.1 km per side-half at this latitude; not a measured waterbody buffer).
queryDefinition.stationCoordinatesMeaning: JICA coordinates identify environmental sampling stations, not fish capture coordinates. The windows are only query geometry and do not claim the station is a catch locality.

widerDiscoveryRectangle.interpretation: A broad rectangular geographic query includes land, estuary, coastal and neighboring localities. Its records are not automatically assigned to the named JICA reaches.

interpretation: The five exact station-centered square windows each returned zero rows. This only describes the GBIF query and geometry used; it is not evidence that fish are absent from the sites.
The wider rectangle returned nine rows, but none can be assigned to one of the five JICA reach/station sites from this query alone.

The query covered COL XR Actinopterygii only. It did not screen sharks, rays, taxa without the selected classification, no-coordinate records, occurrence records omitted by GBIF indexing, or non-GBIF literature.
The query's country, taxon and coordinate filters do not certify field identity, locality, source rights, wild capture, present-day occupancy, catchability, legal access or food safety.
nextStep: Seek a legitimately accessible copy of Angeles (2005) from the National Library or UP Diliman to review its Pampanga River/Apalit fish evidence; continue site-resolved freshwater discovery for the remaining Central Luzon rivers, lakes, reservoirs, wetlands and coastal/brackish leads.
